$comment: Index of Zabbix 6.0 API JSON Schemas. object -> method -> {path,title,description}.

action.get.title: action.get
action.get.description: Retrieve actions according to the given parameters.

alert.get.title: alert.get
alert.get.description: Retrieve alerts according to the given parameters.

apiinfo.version.title: apiinfo.version
apiinfo.version.description: Retrieve the version of the Zabbix API. Only available to unauthenticated users; must be called without the auth parameter.

auditlog.get.title: auditlog.get
auditlog.get.description: Retrieve audit log records according to the given parameters.

autoregistration.get.title: autoregistration.get
autoregistration.get.description: Retrieve the autoregistration object according to the given parameters.

configuration.export.title: configuration.export
configuration.export.description: Export configuration data as a serialized string.

configuration.import.title: configuration.import
configuration.import.description: Import configuration data from a serialized string.

configuration.importcompare.title: configuration.importcompare
configuration.importcompare.description: Compare an import file with current system elements and show what will be changed if the file is imported.

correlation.get.title: correlation.get
correlation.get.description: Retrieve correlations according to the given parameters.

dashboard.get.title: dashboard.get
dashboard.get.description: Retrieve dashboards according to the given parameters.

dashboard.update.title: dashboard.update
dashboard.update.description: Update existing dashboards. The dashboardid property must be specified for each dashboard, all other properties are optional; only the specified properties will be updated.

dcheck.get.title: dcheck.get
dcheck.get.description: Retrieve discovery checks according to the given parameters.

dhost.get.title: dhost.get
dhost.get.description: Retrieve discovered hosts according to the given parameters.

discoveryrule.copy.title: discoveryrule.copy
discoveryrule.copy.description: Copy LLD rules with all of the prototypes to the given hosts.

discoveryrule.get.title: discoveryrule.get
discoveryrule.get.description: Retrieve LLD rules according to the given parameters.

drule.get.title: drule.get
drule.get.description: Retrieve discovery rules according to the given parameters.

dservice.get.title: dservice.get
dservice.get.description: Retrieve discovered services according to the given parameters.

event.acknowledge.title: event.acknowledge
event.acknowledge.description: Update events: close, acknowledge/unacknowledge, add a message, or change severity. Only trigger events (problem events) can be updated.

event.get.title: event.get
event.get.description: Retrieve events according to the given parameters.

graph.get.title: graph.get
graph.get.description: Retrieve graphs according to the given parameters.

graphitem.get.title: graphitem.get
graphitem.get.description: Retrieve graph items according to the given parameters.

graphprototype.get.title: graphprototype.get
graphprototype.get.description: Retrieve graph prototypes according to the given parameters.

graphprototype.update.title: graphprototype.update
graphprototype.update.description: Update existing graph prototypes. The graphid property must be defined for each graph prototype, all other properties are optional; only the passed properties will be updated.

hanode.get.title: hanode.get
hanode.get.description: Retrieve a list of High availability cluster nodes according to the given parameters. Only available to Super admin user types.

history.clear.title: history.clear
history.clear.description: Clear item history. Available only to Admin and Super admin user types (revocable via user role settings).

history.get.title: history.get
history.get.description: Retrieve history data according to the given parameters. May return historical data of a deleted entity if this data has not been removed by the housekeeper yet.

host.get.title: host.get
host.get.description: Retrieve hosts according to the given parameters.

host.massadd.title: host.massadd
host.massadd.description: Simultaneously add multiple related objects to all the given hosts.

host.massremove.title: host.massremove
host.massremove.description: Remove related objects from multiple hosts.

host.massupdate.title: host.massupdate
host.massupdate.description: Simultaneously replace or remove related objects and update properties on multiple hosts.

host.update.title: host.update
host.update.description: Update existing hosts. The hostid property must be defined for each host, all other properties are optional; only given properties are updated. Updating the host technical name also updates the visible name if not given separately.

hostgroup.get.title: hostgroup.get
hostgroup.get.description: Retrieve host groups according to the given parameters.

hostgroup.massadd.title: hostgroup.massadd
hostgroup.massadd.description: Simultaneously add multiple related objects to all the given host groups.

hostgroup.massremove.title: hostgroup.massremove
hostgroup.massremove.description: Remove related objects from multiple host groups.

hostgroup.massupdate.title: hostgroup.massupdate
hostgroup.massupdate.description: Replace hosts and templates with the specified ones in multiple host groups.

hostgroup.update.title: hostgroup.update
hostgroup.update.description: Update existing host groups. The groupid property must be defined for each host group, all other properties are optional; only the given properties are updated.

hostinterface.get.title: hostinterface.get
hostinterface.get.description: Retrieve host interfaces according to the given parameters.

hostinterface.massadd.title: hostinterface.massadd
hostinterface.massadd.description: Simultaneously add host interfaces to multiple hosts.

hostinterface.massremove.title: hostinterface.massremove
hostinterface.massremove.description: Remove host interfaces from the given hosts.

hostinterface.replacehostinterfaces.title: hostinterface.replacehostinterfaces
hostinterface.replacehostinterfaces.description: Replace all host interfaces on a given host.

hostinterface.update.title: hostinterface.update
hostinterface.update.description: Update existing host interfaces. The interfaceid property must be defined for each host interface; all other properties are optional and only the given properties will be updated.

hostprototype.get.title: hostprototype.get
hostprototype.get.description: Retrieve host prototypes according to the given parameters.

housekeeping.get.title: housekeeping.get
housekeeping.get.description: Retrieve the housekeeping object according to the given parameters.

httptest.get.title: httptest.get
httptest.get.description: Retrieve web scenarios according to the given parameters.

iconmap.get.title: iconmap.get
iconmap.get.description: Retrieve icon maps according to the given parameters.

image.get.title: image.get
image.get.description: Retrieve images according to the given parameters.

item.create.title: item.create
item.create.description: Create new items. Web items cannot be created via the Zabbix API.

item.delete.title: item.delete
item.delete.description: Delete items. Web items cannot be deleted via the Zabbix API.

item.get.title: item.get
item.get.description: Retrieve items according to the given parameters.

item.update.title: item.update
item.update.description: Update existing items. Web items cannot be updated via the Zabbix API.

itemprototype.get.title: itemprototype.get
itemprototype.get.description: Retrieve item prototypes according to the given parameters.

maintenance.get.title: maintenance.get
maintenance.get.description: Retrieve maintenances according to the given parameters.

map.get.title: map.get
map.get.description: Retrieve maps according to the given parameters.

mediatype.get.title: mediatype.get
mediatype.get.description: Retrieve media types according to the given parameters.

problem.get.title: problem.get
problem.get.description: Retrieve problems according to the given parameters.

proxy.get.title: proxy.get
proxy.get.description: Retrieve proxies according to the given parameters.

proxy.update.title: proxy.update
proxy.update.description: Update existing proxies. The proxyid property must be defined for each proxy, all other properties are optional; only given properties are updated.

regexp.get.title: regexp.get
regexp.get.description: Retrieve global regular expressions according to the given parameters.

report.get.title: report.get
report.get.description: Retrieve scheduled reports according to the given parameters.

role.get.title: role.get
role.get.description: Retrieve user roles according to the given parameters.

script.execute.title: script.execute
script.execute.description: Run a script on a host or event.

script.get.title: script.get
script.get.description: Retrieve scripts according to the given parameters.

script.getscriptsbyhosts.title: script.getscriptsbyhosts
script.getscriptsbyhosts.description: Retrieve scripts available on the given hosts.

script.update.title: script.update
script.update.description: Update existing scripts. The scriptid property must be defined for each script, all other properties are optional. Only the passed properties will be updated, all others will remain unchanged. An exception is the type property change from 5 (Webhook) to other: the parameters property will be cleaned.

service.get.title: service.get
service.get.description: Retrieve services according to the given parameters.

service.update.title: service.update
service.update.description: Update existing services. The serviceid property must be defined for each service, all other properties are optional; only the passed properties are updated.

settings.get.title: settings.get
settings.get.description: Retrieve the common administration settings object.

settings.update.title: settings.update
settings.update.description: Update the common administration settings. Available only to the Super admin user type.

sla.get.title: sla.get
sla.get.description: Retrieve SLA objects according to the given parameters.

sla.getsli.title: sla.getsli
sla.getsli.description: Calculate the Service Level Indicator (SLI) data for a Service Level Agreement (SLA).

task.create.title: task.create
task.create.description: Create a new task, such as collecting diagnostic data or checking items/low-level discovery rules without a config reload. Only available to the Super admin user type.

task.get.title: task.get
task.get.description: Retrieve tasks according to the given parameters. Returns details only about 'Diagnostic information' tasks. Only available to the Super admin user type.

template.delete.title: template.delete
template.delete.description: Delete templates. Deleting a template will cause deletion of all template entities (items, triggers, graphs, etc.).

template.get.title: template.get
template.get.description: Retrieve templates according to the given parameters.

template.massadd.title: template.massadd
template.massadd.description: Simultaneously add multiple related objects to the given templates.

template.massremove.title: template.massremove
template.massremove.description: Remove related objects from multiple templates.

template.massupdate.title: template.massupdate
template.massupdate.description: Simultaneously replace or remove related objects and update properties on multiple templates.

template.update.title: template.update
template.update.description: Update existing templates. The templateid property must be defined for each template, all other properties are optional; only given properties are updated.

templatedashboard.get.title: templatedashboard.get
templatedashboard.get.description: Retrieve template dashboards according to the given parameters.

templatedashboard.update.title: templatedashboard.update
templatedashboard.update.description: Update existing template dashboards. The dashboardid property must be specified for each dashboard, all other properties are optional; only the specified properties will be updated.

token.create.title: token.create
token.create.description: Create new tokens. A token created by this method also has to be generated (token.generate) before it is usable.

token.generate.title: token.generate
token.generate.description: Generate tokens. A token can be generated by this method only if it has already been created (token.create).

token.get.title: token.get
token.get.description: Retrieve tokens according to the given parameters.

token.update.title: token.update
token.update.description: Update existing tokens. The tokenid property must be defined for each token; all other properties are optional and only passed properties are updated.

trend.get.title: trend.get
trend.get.description: Retrieve trend data according to the given parameters.

trigger.create.title: trigger.create
trigger.create.description: Create new triggers. The trigger expression has to be given in its expanded form.

trigger.deletedependencies.title: trigger.deletedependencies
trigger.deletedependencies.description: Delete all trigger dependencies from the given triggers. The documented parameter type is (string/array) of trigger IDs, but the official example sends an array of trigger objects with the triggerid property; both forms are modeled here.

trigger.get.title: trigger.get
trigger.get.description: Retrieve triggers according to the given parameters.

trigger.update.title: trigger.update
trigger.update.description: Update existing triggers. The triggerid property must be defined for each trigger, all other properties are optional; only given properties are updated. The trigger expression has to be given in its expanded form.

triggerprototype.get.title: triggerprototype.get
triggerprototype.get.description: Retrieve trigger prototypes according to the given parameters.

user.checkAuthentication.title: user.checkAuthentication
user.checkAuthentication.description: Check and prolong a user session.

user.get.title: user.get
user.get.description: Retrieve users according to the given parameters.

user.login.title: user.login
user.login.description: Log in to the API and generate an authentication token.

user.logout.title: user.logout
user.logout.description: Log out of the API and invalidate the current authentication token.

usergroup.get.title: usergroup.get
usergroup.get.description: Retrieve user groups according to the given parameters.

usermacro.get.title: usermacro.get
usermacro.get.description: Retrieve host and global macros according to the given parameters.

usermacro.update.title: usermacro.update
usermacro.update.description: Update existing host macros. The hostmacroid property must be defined for each host macro, all other properties are optional and only passed properties will be updated.

usermacro.updateglobal.title: usermacro.updateglobal
usermacro.updateglobal.description: Update existing global macros. The globalmacroid property must be defined for each global macro, all other properties are optional and only passed properties will be updated.

valuemap.get.title: valuemap.get
valuemap.get.description: Retrieve value maps according to the given parameters.
